sections.title: First Quest
sections.note: In a rough order of play. Screens are given as column A–P (west to east) and row 1–8 (north to south); the start is H8.

items.name: Wooden Sword
items.howTo: The Old Man in the cave by the start: "IT'S DANGEROUS TO GO ALONE! TAKE THIS."

items.name: Bombs
items.howTo: Dropped by enemies, or 4 for 20 Rupees in some shops. Link carries 8 at first.

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: Dropped by the Goriyas in Level 1.

items.name: Bow
items.howTo: In Level 1.

items.name: Arrow
items.howTo: Bought for 80 Rupees. Each shot then costs 1 Rupee; it needs the Bow to fire.

items.name: Blue Candle
items.howTo: Bought for 60 Rupees. One flame per screen; burns bushes to find secrets.

items.name: Magical Shield
items.howTo: Sold in shops for 160, 130 or 90 Rupees, depending on the shop. A Like Like can eat it.

items.name: Food
items.howTo: Bought for 100 Rupees, or 60 at the shop that sells the Blue Ring. Feeds a hungry Goriya in Level 7.

items.name: Letter
items.area: Cave up the stairs northeast of the Lost Hills (O1)
items.howTo: From an Old Man. Show it to an Old Woman to buy Water of Life from her.

items.name: Water of Life (Blue)
items.howTo: Bought for 40 Rupees once you've shown the Letter. Refills every heart once.

items.name: Water of Life (Red)
items.howTo: Bought for 68 Rupees once you've shown the Letter. Two uses: it turns blue after the first.

items.name: Magical Boomerang
items.howTo: Held by the Blue Goriyas in Level 2.

items.name: Raft
items.howTo: In Level 3, down a staircase.

items.name: Power Bracelet
items.area: Death Mountain foothills, east of the Graveyard (E3)
items.howTo: Under the top-right Armos statue: touch it and it comes to life, leaving the bracelet behind. Lets Link push boulders, which opens the warp caves.

items.name: White Sword
items.howTo: From the Old Man in the cave at the top of the waterfall river, once Link has at least 5 Heart Containers.

items.name: Blue Ring
items.area: Shop under an Armos on Lake Hylia's northwest shore (E4)
items.howTo: Push the top-middle Armos for the shop's stairs; the ring costs 250 Rupees. Takes half damage.

items.name: Stepladder
items.howTo: In Level 4, and needed later in the same level.

items.name: Recorder
items.howTo: Defeats Digdogger, warps between levels and opens hidden Level 7.

items.name: Bomb upgrade (12 bombs)
items.howTo: An Old Man in a hidden room raises the bomb limit by 4 for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Magical Rod
items.howTo: Shoots a magic wave; fire with the Book of Magic.

items.name: Red Candle
items.howTo: In Level 7. Any number of flames per screen.

items.name: Bomb upgrade (16 bombs)
items.howTo: An Old Man in a hidden room raises the bomb limit by 4 more for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Book of Magic
items.howTo: The Magical Rod's waves set fire where they land.

items.name: Magical Key
items.howTo: Opens every locked door.

items.name: Magical Sword
items.howTo: Push the third tombstone from the left in the middle row for the stairs, who gives it once Link has at least 12 Heart Containers.

items.name: Silver Arrow
items.howTo: In Level 9. The only arrow that can finish Ganon.

items.name: Red Ring
items.howTo: In Level 9. Takes a quarter of the damage.

sections.title: Second Quest

items.name: Bombs

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: Dropped by the Goriyas in Level 1.

items.name: Bow
items.howTo: In Level 5 (in the First Quest it was in Level 1).

items.name: Recorder

items.name: Bomb upgrade (12 bombs)
items.howTo: An Old Man in a hidden room raises the bomb limit by 4 for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Magical Rod
items.howTo: Shoots a magic wave; fire with the Book of Magic.

items.name: Red Candle
items.howTo: In Level 7. Any number of flames per screen.

items.name: Bomb upgrade (16 bombs)
items.howTo: An Old Man in a hidden room raises the bomb limit by 4 more for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Book of Magic
items.howTo: The Magical Rod's waves set fire where they land.

items.name: Magical Key
items.howTo: Opens every locked door. A hungry Goriya blocks the way: bring Food.

items.name: Magical Sword
items.area: Under the leftmost boulder one screen west of the White Sword cave (J1)
items.howTo: The stairs lead to an Old Man, who gives it once Link has at least 12 Heart Containers.

items.name: Silver Arrow
items.howTo: In Level 9. The only arrow that can finish Ganon.

items.name: Red Ring
items.howTo: In Level 9. Takes a quarter of the damage.
